findings.title: Sourcing before compinit executes completion during shell startup
findings.why_it_matters: A zshrc that sources the generated file before initializing completion prints an _arguments error and does not register ripgrep completion; the FAQ does not specify an ordering requirement.
evidence: In a clean zsh, sourcing the file before compinit produces '_rg:341: command not found: _arguments' and returns status 1; the compdef registration branch is skipped.
FAQ.md:131-135 recommends adding the source command to zshrc without requiring compinit first.
findings.suggested_fix: Distinguish autoload execution from sourcing without treating an absent compdef as autoload, and document that compinit must run before direct sourcing (or arrange deferred registration).

findings.title: Copying the zshrc example runs a nonexistent command
findings.why_it_matters: The instruction says to add the displayed line to .zshrc, but its leading prompt marker is parsed as a command, so startup reports 'command not found: $' and never loads the completion.
evidence: In zsh, executing '$ source /tmp/review-rg-completion.zsh' reports 'command not found: $'.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the leading '$ ' from the line intended to be added to .zshrc.
